**Passport (ISO code and country):** XX —

**Where you travel most (optional):**

The app already has basic rules for every passport (from passport-index-data). In-depth research checks, from official sources, how the days are counted for every destination. The owner adds the passport to `passports.json`; the next twice-yearly run researches it.
